content.value_statement: Advanced data science work often needs statistical rigor, production judgment, and clear communication. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan experiments, evaluate models, and explain analytics tradeoffs.
actual_capabilities: Frames statistical modeling and causal inference approaches for analytics problems.
Outlines experiment design workflows, including metrics, power, controls, and rollout risks.
Guides feature engineering patterns for batch, real-time, and production machine learning systems.
Reviews model evaluation plans with drift checks, monitoring, and business impact criteria.
Supports stakeholder communication by translating data science tradeoffs into concise recommendations.
limitations: The included scripts are lightweight templates and do not implement complete modeling pipelines.
It does not supply datasets, trained models, or production infrastructure.
It cannot replace statistical review for regulated or high-risk decisions.
Recommendations depend on the quality and completeness of the user provided context.

use_cases.title: Design Product Experiments
use_cases.description: Create an experiment plan with hypotheses, guardrail metrics, sample sizing considerations, and analysis risks.

use_cases.title: Review ML Evaluation Plans
use_cases.description: Assess offline metrics, validation strategy, monitoring needs, and deployment readiness before model launch.

use_cases.title: Plan Analytics Architecture
use_cases.description: Map feature pipelines, data quality checks, and reporting layers for scalable decision support.

prompt_templates.title: Define an Analysis Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a structured data science approach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create an analysis plan for this business question: [question]. Include the dataset needed, core metrics, statistical method, assumptions, and decision criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Experiment
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for A/B test planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an experiment for [product change]. Include hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, targeting, randomization unit, duration considerations, and risks to validity.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for model validation and launch review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this model evaluation plan: [plan]. Identify missing validation checks, metric risks, bias concerns, monitoring needs, and launch criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production ML System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for end-to-end data science system design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production data science design for [use case]. Cover feature pipelines, training workflow, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining triggers, and stakeholder reporting.

output_examples.input: Design an experiment to test a new onboarding flow for a SaaS product.
output_examples.output: A structured plan with hypothesis, conversion metric, retention guardrails, eligible population, randomization unit, power considerations, launch phases, and validity risks.

output_examples.input: Review whether a churn model is ready for production.
output_examples.output: A readiness review covering validation split quality, calibration, business lift, fairness checks, monitoring metrics, drift alerts, and rollback criteria.

output_examples.input: Plan feature engineering for real-time fraud detection.
output_examples.output: A feature strategy with online and batch features, freshness requirements, leakage controls, data quality checks, latency constraints, and ownership boundaries.

best_practices: Provide the business decision, available data, constraints, and tolerance for false positives or false negatives.
Ask for assumptions, risks, and validation checks before acting on statistical recommendations.
Use the skill to prepare reviews, then validate final methods with domain and compliance stakeholders.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a model recommendation without explaining the target outcome and data collection process.
Do not treat example scripts as complete production pipelines without implementation work.
Do not use statistical output as the sole basis for legal, medical, or regulated decisions.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure data science work across experiments, models, feature engineering, causal analysis, and analytics communication.

faq.question: Does it run full machine learning pipelines?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts are templates. They show structure but do not implement full training or deployment workflows.

faq.question: Can it help with A/B testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline hypotheses, metrics, randomization, sample size considerations, validity risks, and rollout plans.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it handle sensitive data directly?
faq.answer: It does not require sensitive data. Share summaries, schemas, and anonymized examples when possible.

faq.question: Who is the best user for this skill?
faq.answer: It is most useful for data scientists, ML engineers, analytics leaders, and product teams planning data-driven decisions.
